relationships.subject: ssCGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Wildtype and ssCGRP(27-37) bound the ECD with affinities of 1 μM and 0.5 nM, and residence times of 5 s and 8 min, respectively.

relationships.subject: ssCGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: In striking contrast, ssCGRP(1-37) was a very long-acting, sustained signaling agonist with no detectable cAMP decay observed even after 80 min of antagonist challenge (Figure 6C; Table S5).

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP(1-37) was a short-acting agonist with a cAMP decay rate of 0.3 min–1 and half-life of 2.4 min (Figure 6B; Table S5).

relationships.subject: telcagepant
relationships.evidence_quote: The small molecule telcagepant, which is an antagonist of the CGRPR originally developed as a migraine drug, had a Ki of 4.6 nM (Figure 2A)

key_findings: ssCGRP variant binds CGRPR with ~1000-fold higher affinity (27-37) and gives long-duration cAMP signaling; insensitive to G protein allosteric effect.
Equilibrium reaction network model captured wildtype CGRP but not full ssCGRP behavior.
